info.title: Send Payments API Reference
info.description:
## Send Payments API

The Send Payments API provides a flexible way to manage domestic and international payments. 


It's designed to be flexible, allowing a broad range of use cases. This document provides information on the endpoints offered by Send and how to interact with them. You can use these end points to create your own custom workflows or you can implement the workflows we have documented on the Send website.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Every request to the Send Payments API must be signed with the authentication token available by supplying your API Key and Secret.

tags.name: Accounts
tags.description: Account endpoints can be used to register a new user with Send Payments. There are 2 Customer Account types: Corporate and Individual. Customer Accounts have custody of Trading Accounts which are the backbone of the Send ecosystem. When you register a new Customer Account using a POST we'll set up a Trading Account too and both the accountId and tradingAccountId will be included in the response. You'll need to store these IDs as they are used for many important operations such as creating wallets and booking trades.

tags.name: Wallets
tags.description: Wallets are currency specific virtual accounts which you can use to store funds, book trades, internal transfers, external payments and more. Wallets are critical to the central funds management flow of the Send Payments ecosystem. Creation of wallets under a trading account allows a Customer Account to receive funds onto their Trading Account and subsequently book trades and payments.

tags.name: Trades
tags.description: Trades are the means by which Wallets (and thereby, the associated Trading Account) exchange one currency for another. The exchange rate for a trade can either be locked in using a rate sheet or calculated at the market rate when booking.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Payments can be used to either move money between wallets (transfers) or send money to a recipient outside the Send ecosystem (payouts).

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: The webhook endpoints allow you to manage your configuration of webhooks receivable from the Send platform.

tags.name: Sandbox
tags.description: Sandbox endpoints are only valid in our demo environment and can be used to simulate events you would not normally have control over.
